company.name: HYPE Innovation
company.shortDescription: HYPE Innovation offers software and consulting for strategic innovation management
company.description:
HYPE Innovation is a global leader in innovation ecosystem management software and services. With HYPE, organizations can engage employees, customers, and partners in strategy building, idea and partner management, and innovation project management. HYPE’s client community includes global companies such as Airbus, AkzoNobel, UNICEF, Deutsche Post DHL Group, Fujitsu, Mattel, Merck, Nokia, UCSD, and Siemens.

HYPE is headquartered in Bonn, Germany, and maintains major offices in the US and France, as well as minor offices spread across the globe.
